en.headline: Your blood pressure tablet
body: Your blood pressure tablet is called amlodipine.
It helps your blood vessels relax.
Take it at the same time each day.
Tell your doctor if your ankles swell.
en.passage: It relaxes the blood vessels so that blood flows more easily.

ms.headline: Ubat tekanan darah anda
body: Ubat ini membantu saluran darah anda mengendur.
Ambil pada waktu yang sama setiap hari.
Beritahu doktor anda jika buku lali anda bengkak.
ms.passage: It relaxes the blood vessels so that blood flows more easily.

zh.headline: 您的降血压药
body: 您的降血压药叫氨氯地平。
如果脚踝肿了，告诉您的医生。
zh.passage: It relaxes the blood vessels so that blood flows more easily.
